title: A Specific Cervicograph for Women Attempting at Vaginal Delivery After Cesarean Section
brief_summary: The main objective is to evaluate a specific cervicograph (the graph describing the cervical dilation, included in the partograph) for pregnant women with an history of cesarean section, to improve the management of labor for women attempting at a vaginal delivery (VBAC). Women will be randomly assigned to this specific cervicograph (including an action line 2 hours after the alert line), or to the normal cervicograph (no lines). The primary outcome is appropriate detection of dystocia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women in labor, admitted for a VBAC at a gestational age of 37 weeks or more
* Single pregnancy
* Cephalic presentation

Exclusion Criteria:

* More than 1 previous cesarean section
* Multiple pregnancies
* Presentations other than cephalic
* History of low vertical uterotomy, classical or inverted T-shaped
* Past history of myomectomy
* Fetal death
* Fetal anomalies
* Placental anomalies
condition: Attempted Vaginal Delivery After a Cesarean Section
